cells.quote: ART students achieved larger effect sizes for story content and number of words written. T3 students had the largest effect size for story quality.
cells.note: The study reports a positive T3 story-content effect size of .30, but does not report a separate T3-versus-control significance result for story content in the quoted results.

cells.quote: Significant differences computed amongst groups resulted between ART (Dunn & Finley, 2008) and T3 (Katahira, 2012) for intervention story content; T3 also had a significant difference for story quality.
cells.note: The effect size was computed by comparing the experimental group with the control group. The study interprets the quality difference as related to verbalizing ideas during pre-writing, but this mechanism was not directly tested.

O.outcome_detail: quiz accuracy for the symbol rule

cells.quote: Pairwise permutation tests identified a significant difference forsymbolbetween T3 and the T0 baseline after Holm correction (pHolm = 0.0003), with T3 showing substantially higher quiz accuracy (91.7% vs. 47.8%).
cells.note: No study text was available; the quote is reproduced from the wiki entry. No standardized effect size was printed.
